newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's employee arrested for selling marijuana.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's employee arrested for selling marijuana.

text.p: A McDonald's employee has been arrested for selling marijuana at the restaurant's drive-through window, police said on Wednesday.
"It's absolutely unusual," said Monroe Police Public Information Officer Daniel Brennan.
Brennan said Mence Powell, 19, was arrested Monday after a two-month sting operation in which undercover agents bought packets of marijuana from Powell at McDonald's on four separate occasions.

Powell is being held on $20,000 bond. He faces various charges including illegal sale of marijuana within 1,500 feet of a school. If convicted of all charges, he faces a maximum penalty of 69 years in jail, said Brennan.
